get_enum_name_by_number: use EnumTypeWrapper Name method to get the string name of an enum value by its integer number
get_enum_value_by_name: use EnumTypeWrapper Value method to get the integer value of an enum by its string name
list_enum_keys: use EnumTypeWrapper keys method to get a list of all string names defined in the enum
list_enum_items: use EnumTypeWrapper items method to get a list of name-value pairs for all enum values
access_enum_by_attribute: use EnumTypeWrapper getattr to access an enum value by attribute name on the wrapper instance
